integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible standard-library finite diagnostics included; priority remains best-knowledge, independent check outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Proves marker one-cylinder and entropy asymptotics for fixed eventually periodic binary return-distance sets whose periodic tail contains both symbols. Does not assert all-cylinder rates, arbitrary potentials, nonsofic gap families, exact finite-n inequalities or independent validation.
title: An exact residue-phase law for marker bias in finite-type covers of periodic gap shifts
